# ImgDocs - Secure Browser-Native PDF & Image Tools

> ImgDocs is a high-speed, 100% private client-side document processing engine and web application. All PDF conversions, compression, OCR, and editing run directly in browser memory via WebAssembly and JavaScript without uploading files to external servers.

## Key System Capabilities
- 100% Private Client-Side Processing (Files never leave the user's browser)
- Zero Cloud Uploads for core tools (GDPR & HIPAA compliant workflow)
- Ultra-fast conversion, compression, and text extraction
- Built-in Gemini AI Assistant for document intelligence, summarization, and translation
